description: This file defines custom Cypress commands for mocking API interactions, user login UI automation, and setting up authentication tokens within a Cypress testing environment for a web dashboard application.

methods.name: mockApi
methods.description: Sets up interceptors to mock API responses for login, user management, report management, and chart data for testing purposes.

methods.name: loginUI
methods.description: Automates the login process through the UI by filling in credentials and submitting the login form.

methods.name: seedAuth
methods.description: Sets a fake authentication token directly into local storage to bypass UI login.
